Hero.title: Adel Djahnit
Hero.pitch: Currently on assignment at FIBA in Mies, where I develop internal tools for the federation. Based in Divonne-les-Bains as a registered cross-border worker, I am seeking a permanent position in Switzerland following this internship.

items.name: FIBA
items.context: Previously, an organization requesting access to the federation's data API had to submit a paper form, followed by several rounds of correspondence with staff before access was granted.
items.approach: I am developing the automated subscription form intended to replace this process: the applicant submits their information, staff validates the request, and access is then provisioned automatically. Built in C# / ASP.NET Core on the backend and Next.js / React on the frontend, on the federation's Azure infrastructure.
items.result: The form is already operational. As the project is recent, no quantified data is available yet, but the time saved for the team is immediate.

items.name: Bonee
items.context: Mobile budgeting and savings application. I designed the mockups in collaboration with Melvil Cherruau, who reviewed and approved them, and developed the application in its entirety.
items.approach: Built entirely in Flutter/Dart, a technology I learned specifically for this project, including data storage, validation logic, and in-app payment integration via RevenueCat.
items.result: Available on the App Store and Play Store for under two months, with around ten active users to date.

items.name: Kunagi
items.context: The application was already in production when I joined (React Native / Expo, Laravel backend). Over two years, I developed new features and fixed issues, often as the sole developer on the project.
items.approach: I independently managed iOS certificate renewals and resolved a critical incident on the notification queue, where approximately 3,000 messages were about to be sent simultaneously; I was able to limit delivery to around a hundred messages. I also added user-specific flows depending on profile, such as a "gardener" profile with dedicated settings.
items.result: My contribution is mentioned in my letter of recommendation from Kunagi's founder (see below).

items.org: OsUp — bank reconciliation prototype (Vue.js) and showcase website
